title: Find in Mountain Array
description: Find the minimum index of a target value in a mountain array using binary search.
pseudocode:
1. Find peak index using binary search
2. Binary search target in ascending part [0, peak]
3. If not found, binary search in descending part [peak + 1, n - 1]

steps.note: Finding the peak of the mountain array [1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 1]
Searching for target 3 in ascending half [0, 3]
